user.title: Connect to your Velop
user.description: Enter the address and admin password of the primary Velop node. If Use SSL is off, the password is sent unencrypted over your network.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the primary node, for example 192.168.1.1.
data_description.port: Leave empty to use 443 with SSL or 80 without. Common alternatives are 8443.
data_description.use_ssl: Connect over HTTPS. The router certificate is not verified, so self-signed certificates work.

nodes.title: Choose mesh nodes
nodes.description: Found {node_count} mesh node(s). Pick the child nodes to add and optionally assign an area to each node.

data_description.included_children: The primary node is always added.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure your Velop
reconfigure.description: Change how Home Assistant connects. Leave the password empty to keep the stored one.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the primary node.
data_description.password: Leave empty to keep the current password.
data_description.use_ssl: Connect over HTTPS without verifying the certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The router rejected the stored admin password. Enter the current one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the router. Check the address, port and SSL setting.
error.timeout: The router did not answer in time.
error.account_locked: The router has temporarily locked admin sign-in. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.unsupported_device: The address did not answer like a Linksys Velop.
error.not_primary_node: This address is a child node. Use the primary node.
error.invalid_host: Enter a host name or IP address without http://, a path or a port.

abort.already_configured: This Velop is already configured. Its connection details were updated.
abort.wrong_hub: The address belongs to a different Velop than the one being changed.

data_description.fast_interval: How often status and nodes are refreshed (15-600).
data_description.slow_interval: How often firmware status is checked (5-1440).
data_description.included_children: Unselected child nodes are removed from Home Assistant.
data_description.track_all_clients: Create a presence tracker (disabled by default) for every client. Client names and addresses then appear in Home Assistant.
data_description.tracked_clients: Clients that get an enabled presence tracker.
data_description.consider_home: How long a client stays home after it disconnects.

invalid_auth.message: The router rejected the admin password.

account_locked.message: The router has locked admin sign-in. Wait a few minutes.

not_primary_node.message: The configured address is not the primary node.

wrong_hub.message: The router at the configured address is a different Velop.

unknown_node.message: The selected device is not a node of a loaded Velop.

reboot_recent.message: This node was rebooted less than a minute ago.

reboot_failed.message: The router did not accept the reboot command.

account_locked.title: Velop admin sign-in locked
account_locked.description: The router locked or delayed admin sign-in after failed attempts. Wait a few minutes, then reauthenticate the integration.

reboot_node.name: Reboot node
reboot_node.description: Reboots a Velop node. Rebooting the primary node restarts the whole mesh.
